name: Prawf Clwyd
original_name: プラゥヴ クルイード
source:
Yuji is from a famous sorcerer family, but he is unable to use sorcery. One day, he takes Rikka, his younger sister, to entrance ceremony of her school. Her school is a privilage school where talented sorcerers gather from all over the world. His new life as her guardian begins now...

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
裕司出身著名术师家族，自己却无法使用术法。一天，他陪妹妹立夏参加学校的入学典礼。那是一所汇聚世界各地优秀术师的精英学校。裕司作为妹妹监护人的新生活就此开始……

[摘自Himeya Shop]
